A Marketdata&Match é a união de duas líderes em Customer Experience e Marketing Automation, formando uma das maiores potências do setor na América Latina.

Atuamos com excelência em dados, tecnologia e marketing, implementando e operando plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Unimos inteligência analítica, personalização e performance para impulsionar estratégias de CRM e Customer Experience.

Integramos uma equipe multidisciplinar e uma metodologia orientada a resultados, entregando soluções que fortalecem o relacionamento entre marcas e consumidores e promovem experiências relevantes, mensuráveis e escaláveis.

Somos reconhecidos como Parceira do Ano no ecossistema Salesforce, e integramos o maior hub de Martech e CX da América Latina, entregando excelência em toda a jornada de consumo.

Descrição Geral:

Buscamos um(a) Analista de BI Pleno com forte capacidade analítica e visão crítica para interpretar dados, identificar oportunidades e traduzir desafios de negócio em insights acionáveis. A pessoa ideal deve ter facilidade em compreender as dores do cliente e comunicar resultados de forma clara e estruturada, com foco em storytelling e apoio à tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar dados e indicadores de negócio para gerar insights e recomendações estratégicas;
  • Traduzir as dificuldades e necessidades dos clientes em análises objetivas e direcionadas;

  • Não é responsável pela construção de dashboards — foco em análise e interpretação dos dados.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em análise de dados ou business intelligence;
  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas de dados;
  • Experiência com Snowflake, Power BI (para análise e exploração de dados), Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e interpretação de problemas de negócio;
  • Capacidade de transformar dados em histórias e insights acionáveis.

Diferenciais:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Fullstack com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações web completas utilizando a plataforma .NET (incluindo .NET Core e .NET 6+) e a linguagem C#. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas e escaláveis, atuando tanto no backend quanto no frontend, e participando de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, com foco em qualidade e inovação.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas (Fullstack);
  • Criar APIs RESTful robustas e escaláveis no backend, seguindo os padrões do ABP Framework e princípios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD);
  • Implementar interfaces dinâmicas e responsivas no frontend utilizando frameworks modernos como Angular ou React;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server) e ORMs (Entity Framework Core);
  • Desenvolver soluções com bancos de dados NoSQL, principalmente MongoDB, focando em modelos orientados a documentos;
  • Aplicar arquitetura de microsserviços e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participar de processos de CI/CD e realizar deploys em ambiente de nuvem;

Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com a plataforma .NET e linguagem C#;
  • Conhecimento avançado no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Experiência com frameworks frontend modernos como Angular ou React;
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL Server e Entity Framework Core;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com deployment em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.);

title: Interdisciplinary Project Teacher: Science, Grades 6-8
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement, are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

At Avenues, science project teachers work closely with colleagues to design and enact interdisciplinary learning experiences as part of a teaching team within a grade level. In their role as part of a project team, teachers ensure that students act as scientists every day: asking questions, conducting experiments, and learning deeply from the world around them. :

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to design interdisciplinary projects and continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Science teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A burning desire to work as part of a project-based, interdisciplinary team

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in general physical and life sciences, as well as one or more specialized topics (e.g. astronomy, environmental science, engineering, etc.)

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching science, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

description:
Job Title: IT Security Management Specialist LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights:

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world's leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE!

Job Description

We are looking for an IT Security Management Specialist, who will check and assess internal infrastructure for vulnerabilities, identify potential data breach risks, and address them for all Latin American subsidiaries. Monitor and detect any signs of potential data breaches through internal infrastructure and solution and preemptively block any internal or external data breach attempts.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Network vulnerability management (performing scanners, mitigating vulnerabilities, and reporting appropriately);
  • Monitoring vulnerabilities and implementing risk mitigation measures related to GSOC tickets, CVE Notices, Credential Leaks, APTs, and other threats;
  • Managing social media security measures, monitoring vulnerabilities and external and internal risks that may generate incidents;
  • Responsibility for developing, implementing, and monitoring awareness initiatives with all Latin American subsidiaries;
  • Managing activities to ensure subsidiaries control IT inventory with the appropriate security software installed and updated;
  • Ensuring the review of security policies applied to the subsidiaries' proxy and firewall systems;
  • Developing security policies and procedures for application in office and production environments and communicating with and training the subsidiaries' PICs;
  • Ensure the implementation of the physical security policy by subsidiaries and assist in the development of solutions to mitigate physical security risks within the Subsidiaries.

Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Engineering or Information Security.
  • Certifications Security+ and/or CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001, ITIL or others.
  • Advanced English Skills.
  • Spanish Skills will be considered as a plus.
  • Mandatory advanced skills for tools likes Excel, Power Point, Word
  • Elastic experience.

title: Performance Test Engineer
description:
• Project Description:

    • The developed product is a leading software system in the Energy domain, covering all aspects of Oil & Gas production—from geological exploration to the optimization of ongoing operations. Our technology solution enables geologists and geophysicists to efficiently research, visualize, and interpret large volumes of geological data.

    You'll be joining a senior, supportive, and friendly team, committed to delivering high-quality solutions in the industry.

    • Responsibilities:

    • Develop, execute, and maintain performance test plans, scripts, and scenarios for drilling applications.

    • Analyze system behavior under stress, load, and endurance conditions to identify performance bottlenecks and work with development teams for resolution.

    • Use tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, or custom scripts to simulate operational environments typical in drilling operations.

    • Collaborate with software architects, developers, and DevOps to optimize throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

    • Monitor key performance indicators (CPU, memory, I/O, network) during test executions using tools like New Relic and correlate results with backend logs and telemetry data.

    • Create performance benchmark baselines and contribute to SLAs definition for system responsiveness and throughput.

    • Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating performance testing into automated workflows (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

    • Participate in code and architecture reviews to assess and improve system scalability and resiliency.

    • Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

    • Mandatory Skills Description:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

    • 3+ years of experience in performance engineering or testing in enterprise or industrial software.

    • Strong Java and/or C# Core understanding with the ability to debug issues, analyse stacktraces, and perform root cause analysis

    • Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation.

    • Experience with monitoring tools like New Relic, Dynatrace.

    • Solid understanding of network latency, threading/concurrency, memory profiling, and database performance (SQL/NoSQL).

    • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret performance metrics into actionable insights

    • Software development background, ability to modify code

    • Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

    • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or private data centers supporting oilfield operations.

    • Familiarity with oil and gas drilling workflows, real-time data protocols.

    • ISTQB or other performance testing certifications.

    • Languages:

    English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Role Overview:

The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams.   • Assist with sprint planning, stakeholder communications, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to change management through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in business analysis, product design, or related roles, ideally within CRM platforms.
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methods, including writing user stories and partnering with Scrum teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales strongly preferred) and exposure to cloud-based solutions, APIs, and system integrations.

Local Benefits or Selling Statement

This role offers the opportunity to work in a global environment, gaining exposure to local and international stakeholders. You will grow both business and technical skillsets while shaping CRM and enterprise applications that drive real impact across unique business streams.

O Topógrafo de Transmissão de Alta Tensão é responsável por realizar levantamentos topográficos e georreferenciamentos de terrenos, alinhamentos e estruturas destinados à implantação de linhas de transmissão e subestações. Atua em campo e em escritório, garantindo a precisão dos dados utilizados em projetos, obras e montagens eletromecânicas.

Principais Atividades

  • Executar levantamentos topográficos planialtimétricos e cadastrais para traçados de linhas de transmissão e acessos.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:

They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.

What You'll Do:

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

OPPO's footprint extends to more than 70 countries and regions, with over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers, where it employs more than 40,000 people dedicated to creating a better life for customers around the world through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

Supplier Management

  • Take on the procurement needs of materials (such as administrative supplies, warehousing logistics, service procurement, etc.), actively search for, evaluate, and screen potential suppliers and maintain a supplier database.

Procurement Execution

  • Develop detailed procurement plans based on the company's business needs, arrange the procurement schedule reasonably to ensure the timely, high-quality, and sufficient supply of materials, and avoid inventory overstock or stockouts.
  • Monitor the execution of procurement orders, communicate and coordinate with suppliers and relevant internal departments in a timely manner, resolve any abnormal situations that arise during the procurement process.
  • Be responsible for the acceptance of procurement materials, assist the demand personnel in verifying the quantity, specifications, quality, and other information of the goods to ensure that the warehoused materials meet the requirements, and handle the return and replacement procedures for non-conforming goods in a timely manner.

Cost Control

  • Keep track of the procurement cost levels of similar products in the industry through market research, inquiries, and price comparisons, and provide data support for the company's procurement decisions.

Information Management

  • Organize and file procurement contracts, invoices, acceptance documents, and other relevant procurement documents to ensure the completeness and accuracy of procurement records for easy reference and auditing.
  • Be proficient in using the procurement system to conduct work, update the data in the procurement system in a timely manner, including supplier information, procurement order status, inventory dynamics, etc., and provide accurate procurement data reports for the company to make scientific and rational decisions.

Other Work

  • Assist the superior in completing other tasks related to procurement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above, major.
  • Advanced chinese and portuguese are mandatory.
  • It would be better if you could speak English too.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Be able to complete tasks on time and ensure work quality.
  • Be able to work under pressure.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Realizar a gestão da execução dos planos de manutenção automotiva em todas as suas classes, primária, rodoviária e agrícola, campo e base, alocando recursos com base em confiabilidade e custo, para garantir a sustentação da operação;

  • Realizar gestão de time multidisciplinar, compartilhando estratégias do processo, fazendo gestão de performance e apoiando no desenvolvimento;

Quais os requisitos?

  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Agrícola ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com liderança de oficina automotiva, preferencialmente no setor sucroenergético;
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de manutenção e custos;
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de processos e melhoria contínua (SDCA, PDCA, etc.)

Qual localidade?

Tanabi - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

work MST or PST hours.

title: SAP ABAP Developer / MDG Specialist (Clean Core Focus)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções ABAP que estendam a funcionalidade do SAP MDG, seguindo os princípios de Clean Core (utilizando BAdIs, extensibilidade para key users e extensões side-by-side).
  • Implementar e dar suporte a modelos de dados, workflows e validações no SAP MDG.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais para coletar requisitos e propor soluções técnicas escaláveis e compatíveis com upgrades.
  • Desenvolver regras BRF+, interfaces baseadas em Fiori/UI5 e melhorias específicas do MDG utilizando frameworks de extensibilidade.
  • Garantir que todos os desenvolvimentos sejam compatíveis com os caminhos de upgrade do SAP S/4HANA.
  • Participar de code reviews, aplicando padrões de código limpo e diretrizes de extensibilidade SAP.
  • Apoiar integrações com sistemas externos utilizando APIs, OData e serviços do SAP BTP.
  • Fornecer consultoria técnica e suporte em debugging, troubleshooting e correção de erros para aplicações SAP customizadas.
  • Capacitar outros desenvolvedores, promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar provas de conceito (PoCs) e projetos que envolvam tecnologias emergentes relacionadas ao ecossistema SAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas, guidelines e processos que facilitem o trabalho do time de desenvolvimento SAP.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento ABAP, incluindo:
  • ABAP OO (Object-Oriented ABAP)
  • BAdIs e Enhancement Framework
  • BRF+
  • CDS Views
  • OData e APIs RESTful
  • SAP Fiori/UI5
  • Conceitos de Clean Core e práticas de extensibilidade SAP
  • Técnicas específicas de desenvolvimento para SAP S/4HANA
  • RAP (Restful ABAP Programming) — CDS, Annotations, Behavior Definitions, Managed/Unmanaged Implementation, EML
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) e Business Application Studio (BAS)
  • Conhecimento de Solution Manager (ChaRM, Focused Build)
  • Conhecimento em SAP Master Data Governance (MDG):
  • Modelagem de dados e frameworks de governança
  • INGLÊS AVANÇADO/FLUENTE
  • Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em qualidade técnica
  • Colaboração com equipes funcionais e técnicas
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e alinhamento com o conceito de Clean Core
  • Comunicação clara e espírito de equipe

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

POSITION: Fullstack Developer - Vue / Nuxt
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

AtlasIntel seeks talented Fullstack Engineers with a focus on frontend development. If you excel at building sleek, user-friendly interfaces and solving complex problems, you'll thrive on our team. We value candidates with a strong algorithmic foundation, analytical prowess, and a proactive mindset.

Our ideal engineers are self-starters who can handle dynamic, fast-paced environments, manage multiple projects, and embrace learning new technologies. You'll collaborate with designers, engineers, and stakeholders to drive the next generation of our platforms and tools.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will

  • Develop robust APIs for various applications.
  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.
WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js.
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6), HTML5, CSS, and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt.
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and an ability to learn quickly.
NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python, Java, or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture
ABOUT US

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil's 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Analista Comunicação Junior
description:
ANALISTA COMUNICACAO JR

Sobre a GRU Airport

A GRU Airport, conhecido como o maior aeroporto do Brasil, conecta sonhos, destinos e oportunidades há quase quatro décadas.

Reconhecido como o principal hub da América Latina, a GRU Airport , administradora do Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo, em Guarulhos, é referência em eficiência e conectividade. Porta de entrada do Brasil para o mundo.

Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza a inovação, o desenvolvimento e o impacto positivo na jornada de cada viajante, venha construir o futuro conosco no setor da aviação.

Na GRU, acreditamos que cada colaborador é fundamental para alcançar novos patamares.

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.

Objetivo do Cargo:

O Analista de Performance & Insights é o contador de histórias com dados da equipe de Marketing Direto, responsável por transformar resultados de campanhas e tendências de dados de primeira mão (1P) em insights acionáveis para o negócio. Esse profissional impulsiona a melhoria contínua ao medir o desempenho de CRM & Loyalty, identificar oportunidades de otimização e criar relatórios claros e prontos para tomada de decisão pelos stakeholders internos.

Com sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados de consumidores e relacionamentos entre entidades, essa pessoa conecta informações de diferentes fontes, canais e públicos para identificar os principais fatores de sucesso. É responsável por definir, monitorar e interpretar KPIs relacionados ao crescimento de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e efetividade das campanhas, garantindo que os esforços da equipe sejam mensuráveis, impactantes e alinhados às prioridades do negócio.

O cargo exige compreensão funcional de infraestrutura de dados de marketing e conceitos técnicos, permitindo colaboração eficiente com equipes de analytics, CDP e ativação — garantindo que os insights sejam confiáveis, contextualizados e incorporados às decisões estratégicas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Dados, Mensuração & Otimização:

  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs-chave relacionados a campanhas de CRM & Loyalty, coleta de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e conversão.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de performance de jornadas, e-mails, promoções e programas de dados 1P, traduzindo resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • Identificar tendências de performance e oportunidades de melhoria nos canais (e-mail, push, mídia paga) e fazer recomendações estratégicas para otimização das táticas de ativação.
  • Construir e manter scorecards de campanhas, benchmarks e frameworks de pós-campanha que padronizem a mensuração nos mercados.
  • Garantir que os insights sejam contextualizados, relevantes e facilmente compreendidos por stakeholders não técnicos (ex.: equipes de marca, conteúdo, CRM).

Suporte Estratégico:

  • Atuar como líder analítico da equipe de Marketing Direto, contribuindo para revisões de performance trimestrais e anuais, previsões e planejamento estratégico.
  • Colaborar com líderes de CRM & Ativação de Dados para incorporar aprendizados de dados em estratégias de segmentação, design de jornadas e lógica de público.
  • Monitorar campanhas em andamento para detectar sinais precoces de performance ou problemas, propondo ajustes em tempo real quando necessário.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em hipóteses baseadas em dados, trabalhando com analytics ou equipes de dados para validar e explorar.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhores práticas de mensuração, modelagem de uplift e frameworks de experimentação.

Experiência & Competências Necessárias:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em análise de dados, relatórios de performance ou analytics de marketing, idealmente em CRM, Loyalty ou Engajamento do Consumidor.
  • Forte entendimento de estratégias de dados 1P, métricas de CRM (open rate, CTR, CVR, etc.) e acompanhamento de performance de campanhas de lifecycle.
  • Habilidade em interpretar dados de marketing e transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio.
  • Confortável trabalhando com modelos de dados relacionais e compreendendo relações entre entidades em plataformas como Salesforce CDP ou bancos de dados CRM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, etc.) para gerar visualizações e relatórios claros.
  • Capacidade comprovada de comunicar insights de forma clara e confiante a stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil proativo, com forte visão de negócios e curiosidade para questionar suposições e identificar oportunidades.
  • Inglês avançado

Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em CPG, varejo ou indústrias orientadas a loyalty, com alto volume de campanhas diretas ao consumidor.
  • Familiaridade com Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CDP ou plataformas similares.
  • Experiência com testes A/B, frameworks de experimentação ou análise de lift incremental.
  • Compreensão de métricas do funil de marketing, tendências de engajamento e análise de cohort.
  • Experiência em segmentação de consumidores, modelagem de retenção ou análise de atribuição é um diferencial.

Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.

  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.

title: Operador Logístico - Vaga Afirmativa 50+
description:
O Grupo SBF valoriza a experiência de vida e profissional. Estamos em busca de profissionais 50+ para a posição de Operador Logístico para compor nosso time.

Prazer, Grupo SBF! Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance, da NWB, da OneFan e da X3M, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele? Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Sobre a posição no jogo:

Como Operador Logístico, você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Receber, conferir e liberar pedidos do cliente conforme procedimento interno;
  • Distribuir pedidos na transportadora;
  • Localizar lotes de produtos quando necessário;
  • Manter o local limpo e organizado;
  • Efetuar a liberação dos embarques;
  • Cuidar da conservação e bom uso dos equipamentos e outros recursos de trabalho da área.

O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando;
  • Ter mais de 50 anos;
  • Interesse em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Facilidade para aprender;
  • Facilidade para se relacionar;
  • Comprometimento e organização;
  • Atenção aos detalhes.

OBS: Teremos fretados gratuitos saindo de: Atibaia, Bragança Paulista, Guarulhos, Extrema, Vargem, Terra Preta, Bom Jesus, Joanópolis, Mairiporã, Pinhalzinho e mais regiões. Possibilidade de efetivação.

Vista a camisa, entre em campo com a gente e faça parte da maior operação do ano.

We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  • Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  • Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  • System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  • Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  • Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Senior Lead Technology Architect
description:
DP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.

To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities;
  • Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success;
  • Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors;
  • Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks;
  • Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought;
  • Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Experience and Skills:

  • Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
  • Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
  • Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS SharePoint, Webex and MS Office & Project;
  • Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
  • Strong knowledge of Flutter, React or Stencil.JS
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in the frontend environment
  • Advanced English;
  • Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
  • Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups. Be very competent using tools such as MS PowerPoint;

Education:

  • Degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or related field: A university degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job;
  • PMP certified or equivalent - exceptional foundation project management skills. Must be able to demonstrate a full understanding of the product development and release management life cycles;
  • Certified Scrum Master - be able to demonstrate and show previous experience running agile project teams.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Estagiário(a) de QA

A Hexagon é líder global em soluções de realidade digital, combinando sensores, software e tecnologias autônomas. Estamos colocando dados para trabalhar para aumentar a eficiência, produtividade, qualidade e segurança em aplicações industriais, de fabricação, infraestrutura, setor público e mobilidade.

Nossas tecnologias estão moldando os ecossistemas de produção e relacionados às pessoas para se tornarem cada vez mais conectados e independentes — garantindo um futuro escalável e sustentável.

A divisão de Mineração da Hexagon resolve os desafios das minas subterrâneas e de superfície com tecnologias comprovadas para planejamento, operações e segurança.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente 5,5 bilhões de dólares. Saiba mais em hexagon.com e siga-nos em @HexagonAB.

· Auxiliar na identificação, documentação e rastreamento de bugs, além de colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir a resolução eficaz desses problemas.

· Ajudar na criação, execução e manutenção de testes automatizados e manuais, garantindo a qualidade e a confiabilidade das aplicações.

  • Familiaridade sobre controle de versão de código, como Git
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de teste – como Xray, Selenium, MQTT FX, Testrails, TestLink, Postman ou similares.

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno
description:
Você vai atuar na equipe de Sustentação de Sistemas, dando suporte diário a soluções tecnológicas essenciais para a área assistencial, como gestão de clínicas, diagnóstico por imagens e oncologia — sistemas que impactam diretamente a rotina de médicos, colaboradores e, principalmente, o atendimento aos pacientes. Experiência em suporte de sistemas, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam sistemas assistenciais de diagnóstico por imagem (PACS), é altamente valorizada, assim como conhecimento na plataforma PIXEON.

Suas principais missões serão garantir a continuidade e eficiência dos sistemas, organizar as prioridades das solicitações, atuar como elo entre as áreas de negócio e TI, acompanhar manutenções e resolver incidentes, além de prestar atendimento qualificado aos usuários finais, incluindo médicos cooperados e colaboradores da Unimed Porto Alegre.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir o funcionamento eficiente e contínuo dos sistemas;
  • Prestar suporte técnico de nível II para usuários finais e profissionais de saúde (em alguns dias da semana de forma presencial), resolvendo problemas complexos relacionados aos sistemas assistenciais;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva nos sistemas assistenciais para garantir sua disponibilidade e desempenho adequado;
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para usuários finais e equipe de suporte de nível I, garantindo que entendam como utilizar eficazmente os sistemas assistenciais;
  • Gerenciar incidentes reportados pelos usuários, seguindo procedimentos de resolução de problemas e escalando quando necessário;
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada sobre os sistemas assistenciais, incluindo procedimentos de suporte e resolução de problemas;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento de software, garantindo que as necessidades dos usuários finais sejam atendidas nos sistemas assistenciais;
  • Assegurar que os sistemas assistenciais estejam em conformidade com normas e regulamentações específicas da área de saúde e da cooperativa.

  • Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia.

Qualificações:

  • Experiência em suporte de sistemas, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam sistemas assistenciais de diagnóstico por imagem (PACS) altamente valorizado conhecimento na plataforma.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão hospitalar.
  • Compreensão de redes de computadores, segurança de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e Oracle, será considerado um diferencial.

Supervisionar e orientar uma equipe de associados de aquisição de clientes para atingir as metas de vendas da empresa no espaço B2B brasileiro. Isso envolve planejamento estratégico, orientação e apoio direto para garantir o sucesso da equipe.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Consultor(a) de Operações de E-mail - Gerente de Implementação de E-mail - 100% home office - Inglês avançado
description:
Título do cargo: Consultor(a) de Operações de E-mail – Gerente de Implementação de E-mail

Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.

Objetivo do Cargo:

O Consultor de Operações de E-mail garante que cada e-mail seja totalmente revisado, validado e pronto para envio em campanhas de CRM e Loyalty. Com conhecimento especializado no Content Builder do Salesforce Marketing Cloud e nas melhores práticas de QA, este cargo é responsável por montar e revisar ativos de e-mail utilizando templates e módulos pré-aprovados disponíveis na plataforma.

Este cargo executa verificações detalhadas de qualidade em textos, layout, conteúdo dinâmico, links, parâmetros de rastreamento, rodapés legais e localização, garantindo consistência, precisão e conformidade com a marca. Também verifica se todos os ativos estão corretamente implementados na estrutura modular e se são exibidos corretamente em diferentes dispositivos e clientes de e-mail.

O Consultor trabalha em estreita colaboração com a equipe de Conteúdo para confirmar a prontidão dos ativos e coordena diretamente com os papéis de Ativação e Coordenação para atender todos os checkpoints de QA antes do lançamento da campanha. Como especialista da equipe em configuração e validação de conteúdo, este cargo desempenha papel fundamental em garantir precisão operacional e experiências prontas para o consumidor — sem necessidade de codificação técnica ou desenvolvimento backend.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Execução na Plataforma & Garantia de Qualidade:

  • Responsabilizar-se pelo processo completo de QA de ativos de e-mail criados no SFMC usando templates drag-and-drop ou blocos de conteúdo aprovados.
  • Garantir que todos os ativos da campanha atendam aos padrões visuais, funcionais e de branding antes do envio.
  • Realizar pré-visualizações, validações de links, checagem de linhas de assunto e validações de conteúdo dinâmico para detectar e corrigir inconsistências.
  • Manter documentação dos protocolos de QA e otimizar continuamente checklists e processos internos de validação.
  • Aproveitar recursos nativos da plataforma, como teste de linhas de assunto e blocos de conteúdo preditivo (ex.: Einstein Recommendations), para validar e melhorar o desempenho do e-mail, quando aplicável.

Colaboração Multifuncional:

  • Comunicar-se com a equipe de Conteúdo para monitorar a prontidão dos ativos e confirmar a entrega pontual de imagens, textos e outros componentes criativos.
  • Colaborar com os papéis de Ativação e Coordenação de Campanhas para alinhar cronogramas e garantir que todos os checkpoints de QA sejam atendidos antes do go-live.
  • Trabalhar com equipes técnicas quando necessário para sinalizar problemas fora do escopo drag-and-drop ou que exijam correções backend.

Excelência Operacional & Melhoria Contínua:

  • Identificar problemas recorrentes de QA e recomendar melhorias em templates, módulos de conteúdo ou processos de campanha para reduzir erros ao longo do tempo.
  • Apoiar a troca de conhecimento dentro da equipe documentando aprendizados de QA e melhores práticas específicas da plataforma.
  • Defender a importância da qualidade e atenção aos detalhes como elementos críticos da experiência do consumidor.

Experiência & Competências Requeridas:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de marketing por e-mail, QA ou funções relacionadas, com forte ênfase em validação de campanhas e prontidão de execução.
  • Expertise comprovada no Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Content Builder, Preview & Test tools) e/ou plataformas de automação de marketing similares.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes, com paixão por manter consistência de marca, precisão técnica e experiências impecáveis para o consumidor.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de e-mails (ex.: Litmus ou Email on Acid) e melhores práticas de teste cross-device.
  • Excelente organização e gestão de tempo para gerenciar QA de múltiplas campanhas sob prazos apertados.
  • Forte habilidade de colaboração para trabalhar em estreita parceria com as equipes de Conteúdo, Ativação e técnicas.
  • Inglês avançado

Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos, idealmente em FMCG/CPG, varejo ou indústrias orientadas por dados.
  • Conhecimento básico de métricas de desempenho de e-mail e como o QA contribui para o sucesso geral (ex.: entregabilidade, CTR, taxas de erro).
  • Experiência com recursos da plataforma como Einstein Copy Insights ou teste de linhas de assunto para melhoria de performance.
  • Compreensão de padrões de acessibilidade e conformidade de e-mail (ex.: CAN-SPAM, GDPR) é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alto volume e regulados.
  • Certificação Salesforce Email Specialist ou equivalente.

Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.

Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

Como se Candidatar
